needed.evidence: A person on foot is standing in the roadway on the right, indicating the footway is not being used or is obstructed.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built sidewalk on the right side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Multiple vehicles are parked along the left curb, occupying the space where a footway would be.
needed.suggestion: Implement a no-parking zone along the left curb to keep the pedestrian path clear and unobstructed.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the mixed-use area and visible pedestrians, but no marked or signalised crossing is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this location to provide a safe and controlled point for people to cross the road.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs are visible at any potential crossing point, which would be a barrier for wheelchairs and prams.
needed.suggestion: Build a raised crossing with integrated dropped kerbs to improve accessibility and safety for all users.
